summary: Titan America SA (NYSE: TTAM) filed a Form 6-K on May 1, 2026, announcing the closing of its acquisition of Keystone Cement Holdings, Inc. and Keystone Cement Company LLC. The target adds 990,000 short tons per year of clinker production capacity and substantial mineral assets supporting over 50 years of cement production. Terms such as price per share, total value, premium, and advisors were not disclosed in the filing. The acquisition aligns with Titan's long-term growth strategy in the Mid-Atlantic region. As a completed deal, the risk-arb angle is moot; focus on integration and capacity utilization.
